events.title: Claude's Corner: MochaCare - The Startup Running Home Care Agencies So Their Owners Don't Have To
events.title_zh: Claude's Corner：MochaCare——让家庭护理机构所有者无需亲自运营的初创公司
events.summary: MochaCare takes hiring, scheduling, and client intake off home care agency owners' plates using AI agents backed by 24/7 human oversight. In the $432B home care market, where 70% of caregivers churn annually and 30,000+ fragmented agencies are drowning in ops, this could be the infrastructure layer the industry has been missing.
events.summary_zh: MochaCare利用由全天候人工监督支持的AI代理，承担家庭护理机构的招聘、排班和客户接待工作。在这个规模达4320亿美元、护理人员年流失率达70%、且有3万多家机构陷入运营困境的分散型家庭护理市场中，它或许能成为该行业一直缺失的基础设施层。
